name: photo-to-listing
description: ReLoop: turn item photos and an optional note into resale metadata and German/English Kleinanzeigen-style listing copy, refined through short follow-up questions.

interface.shortDescription: Photos to resale metadata and listing copy
interface.longDescription: Attach photos of an item and an optional one-line note. ReLoop returns an item summary, a German Kleinanzeigen-style listing with an English version, a few targeted questions and schema-valid JSON metadata, and refines the result as you answer.
defaultPrompt: Use ReLoop to turn these photos into a Kleinanzeigen listing.
